name: St. Moritz (Corviglia, Corvatsch, Diavolezza)
locality: St. Moritz (Corviglia/Piz Nair); Corvatsch/Furtschellas above Silvaplana and Sils; Diavolezza/Lagalb towards the Bernina Pass
operator: Engadin St. Moritz Mountains AG (Corviglia) and the Corvatsch and Diavolezza/Lagalb operators (reference)

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate St. Moritz Dorf (Corviglia funicular area)

Base 1,772 m and Corviglia top 3,057 m (Piz Nair) per a skiresort.info-style summary; the resort-wide top, 3,303 m at Corvatsch, comes from the same search ('highest point in the St. Moritz valley'). Diavolezza reaches about 3,000 m. Vertical derived as the difference.

Search summary: the Upper Engadine lifts give access to 350 km of slopes (whole region incl. Corviglia, Corvatsch/Furtschellas, Diavolezza/Lagalb and smaller areas). Corviglia alone: 155 km (42 km blue, 79 km red, 34 km black, plus 8 km off-piste routes) and 23 lifts (some sources 24). Total lift count, lift types and uphill capacity for the region not found. Search summary did not tie this to one result; cited URL is the most likely source.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Ski schools and rental shops operate in St. Moritz; other features not on file

character: The Upper Engadine ski areas around St. Moritz: Corviglia/Piz Nair directly above the town, Corvatsch/Furtschellas across the lakes above Silvaplana (top station 3,303 m) and Diavolezza/Lagalb towards the Bernina Pass with views of the Bernina massif and the Morteratsch glacier. One regional Engadin pass covers about 350 km of slopes.
learning: Corviglia has 42 km of blue pistes (search summary); ski schools operate in St. Moritz (reference). Confirm beginner areas.
